items.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) was limited on Wednesday.
items.text: Meyers has been dealing with this ankle issue for weeks now, but it has not impacted his game-day availability. Meyers is FLEX-viable against a soft Titans pass defense in Week 12. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) is practicing in full for Week 12 against the Jaguars.
items.text: Tate returned from his multi-week absence last week, posting a 2/58/1 receiving line. He faces the Jaguars’ capable defense in Week 12, but his role and talent keep him in the WR3 tier. Tate looks like a classic rookie wide receiver set to produce late in the season. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Abdul Carter (ankle/calf) did not practice on Wednesday.
items.text: Carter is firmly in the questionable camp for the Giants’ Week 12 game against the lowly Colts. Giants LB Arvell Reese (back) was limited at today’s practice. Hopefully, one or both of them are good to go this weekend. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Isaiah Williams (ribs) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
items.text: Williams missed last week with the rib issue. Omar Cooper was also out, allowing Sterling Shepard to take over the No. 3 receiver role. Shepard saw two targets and managed to get into the end zone on both of them. Cooper appears to be out again this week, but Williams is trending in the right direction. Needless to say, we can’t recommend Shepard (or Williams) in fantasy leagues this week. - Kyle Dvorchak

items.title: Isaiah Likely (groin) was limited on Wednesday.
items.text: Likely injured his groin during practice last week and caught just one pass for 35 yards on Sunday against the Jaguars. His early-week participation is a good sign for his overall health. He will be in the TE1 ranks this week against the Colts. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: D.J. Reed (hip) is not on the final injury report and will play in Week 12 against the Bears.
items.text: Lions EDGE DJ Wonnum (back) and S Chuck Clark (hamstring) are both questionable to play on Thursday. The Lions’ defense was already a fantasy-friendly unit before losing Aidan Hutchinson (knee) for the year. Bears skill position players should be in fantasy football lineups this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Sam LaPorta (ankle) is not on the final injury report and will play in Week 12 against the Bears.
items.text: LaPorta began the week with a limited session before upgrading to full on Tuesday. The Lions’ No. 1 tight end should play a full complement of snaps in what will likely be a high-scoring game environment on Thursday. He should be in fantasy football lineups. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Michael Pittman (foot) practiced in full on Wednesday.
items.text: Pittman is expected to return from injured reserve for Week 12 against the Broncos. Two full practices to open the week keep him on track to suit up on Friday. With Aaron Rodgers gone and the Steelers’ receiver room at full strength, Pittman will be a weak FLEX option if activated from IR. - Kyle Dvorchak

items.title: Rams activated DT Kobie Turner (groin) from injured reserve.
items.text: Turner missed a month while on IR because of the groin issue. He will be active tonight for a must-win game against the Packers. Turner made six starts this year. He has 22 combined tackles with two passbreakups. - Kyle Dvorchak

items.title: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said he thinks De’Zhaun Stribling (ankle) is “a couple of weeks away” from returning.
items.text: Exactly 10 weeks ago, it was reported that Stribling was expected to miss 10 weeks after undergoing surgery on his ankle. Unfortunately, it sounds like he needs more time to recover. ESPN’s Nick Wagoner believes Shanahan’s comments are in reference to Stribling “returning to practice, not necessarily playing.” Hopefully, Shanahan is actually referring to the latter timeframe. Regardless, Stribling should be stashed on fantasy football benches. - Nic Bodiford
